City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 12, 2014 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 10/15/14 Regular Meeting and the 10/22/14 Special Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2014-11-12 Item 8A - Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2014-11-12 Item 8B - Warrants
8C.
Acceptance Hazard Mitigation Grant Program funds and adoption of resolution 2014-63 designating the Director of Public Works, or his designee as an authorized representative for the City of Encinitas to execute applications and contracts with the California Governor's Office of Emergency Services for the Hazard Mitigation Grant Program. Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Villa
1) Accept grant funds from the California Governor's Office of Emergency Service, Hazard Mitigation Grant Program in the amount of $830,430 for the El Camino Real Channel Drainage Improvement project (CD06D); and 2) Adopt Resolution 2014-63, designating the Director of Public Works, or his designee, as an authorized representative for the City of Encinitas to execute applications and contracts with the California Governor's Office of Emergency Services for the Hazard Mitigation Grant Program.
2014-11-12 Item 8C - Hazard Mitigation Grant Program
8D.
Summary vacation of an unused portion of road right-of way located at 758-760 DeWitt Avenue. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Maher
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014-57 approving the summary vacation of a portion of Dewitt Avenue right-of-way fronting the property at 758-760 Dewitt Avenue.
2014-11-12 Item 8D - Summary Vacation on DeWitt
8E.
Consideration and possible adoption of a fourth implementation agreement addendum to the Encinitas Ranch Development Agreement (Development Agreement) - incorporating recommendations of the Encinitas Ranch Golf Authority (ERGA) Council Subcommittee approved by City Council. Contact Persons: Finance Director Nash and City Attorney Sabine
Receive the report and adopt a fourth implementation agreement addendum to the Encinitas Ranch Development Agreement (Development Agreement).
2014-11-12 Item 8E - ERGA Implementation Agreement
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Street Design Standards. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Maher
Receive the Staff Report and direct staff to return to the City Council with any changes required to codify the new Public Road Standards.
2014-11-12 Item 10A - Street Design Standards
10B.
Fundraising Policy Subcommittee Report. Contact Persons: Council Members Barth & Shaffer
Review the subcommittee recommendations and authorize the development of a City-wide Policy addressing issues identified in the agenda report including Council direction.
2014-11-12 Item 10B - Fundraising Subcommittee Report
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS There are no Information Items.
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM There are no Council Member initiated Items.
13.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COUNCIL MEMBERS
14.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
15.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS / PENDING FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
2014-11-12 Item 15 - City Manager Follow Up Log
16.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
17.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
